title: An AI Made a 3D Shooter in One File
script: An AI made a playable 3D shooter in one file. One prompt. No human feedback during the build. An Anthropic engineer ran Claude Fable 5.2 for about eight hours. The result: Saltline, a free browser shooter set in a rainy harbor. The whole game is one 1.4 megabyte file. No separate images, audio files, or 3D models. Code generates the visuals and the sound. Estimated API cost: about five hundred fifty dollars.
cta: Follow AI Tested for AI builds that bend reality.
